text:
mia: Heads-up — planning a press + analyst briefing for the Dedicated launch next Weds (May 22). Can we lock an embargo window? Need quotes cleared and a quick fact-check packet.

leo: +1. For embargo: prefer 24h embargo to accommodate AP/print. Is that okay with product/legal? :thinking_face:

ana: legal sign-off is fine with 24h. Need final quote text and data points by EOD Mon so we can clear.

mia: Note — reporters invited: TechCrunch (katie), The Verge (omar), Bloomberg AI (li), and two industry analysts. I'll paste list in a min.

press_bot: calendar invite created: "Redwood Dedicated press + analyst briefing" — 2024-05-22 16:00 PT. Recording enabled. Link: https://cal.example.com/meet/abc123

sam: Can we get a short approved quote from Ezra for the press pack? Suggested: "Redwood Dedicated makes enterprise inference predictable and cost-efficient at scale."

emily: That reads fine but legal prefers slightly softer: "Redwood Dedicated helps engineering teams run inference more predictably while optimizing cost and latency."

jordan: For fact-check packet, include: benchmarks (p50/p95 latency), typical throughput, GPU SKU used, dataset descriptions (anonymized), and a brief note on routing/fallback behavior. I'll assemble the doc.

mia: Perfect. Two quick asks: 1) Quote approval: can Ezra or product ops confirm final copy by Mon 17:00 PT? 2) Embargo statement we give to reporters: "Embargo until 2024-05-22 16:00 PT" — OK?

leo: Ezra prefers to sign off on the second variant from emily. I'll ping him now.

sam: @mia — small tweak to the quote: remove "engineering teams" and use "teams" to broaden. Final suggestion: "Redwood Dedicated helps teams run inference more predictably while optimizing cost and latency."

mia: Noted. Will route that.

ana: Confirmed embargo wording is fine. Legal flags nothing else.

press_bot: Reporter list posted to thread: techcrunch_katie@example.com, verge_omar@example.com, bloomberg_li@example.com, idc_analyst@example.com, forrester_analyst@example.com

jordan: Fact-check doc draft: https://docs.example.com/d/press-factpack-dedicated-v1 — includes benchmark table, methodology notes, and approved model/instance configurations. Please comment inline.

emily: Quick comment in doc — add a short blurb on fallback policy (when dedicated pool is exhausted we route to compatible variant). Helps answer capacity questions.

mia: Thanks all. Plan:
- Mon 17:00 PT: final quote and factpack ready for legal.
- Tue morning: send embargoed outreach with one-pager + factpack.
- Wed 16:00 PT: briefing; recording + follow-up Q&A window.

sam: One more: are we okay sharing the recording with press afterwards? Some outlets ask. Legal?

ana: Allowed, but mark as "for editorial use only" and no redistribution. We'll include that in the outreach email.

leo: Ezra approved the slightly broader quote. Final quote:

```
"Redwood Dedicated helps teams run inference more predictably while optimizing cost and latency." — Ezra, Head of Product
```

mia: Great — I'll update the doc, drop the final quote into the factpack, and get outreach scheduled Tue. Thanks everyone :rocket:

press_bot: Outreach draft scheduled for Tue 09:00 PT. Template: "Embargoed: Redwood Dedicated — briefing invite + factpack". Reminder will fire 24h before briefing.

jordan: I'll tidy the factpack and tag the items that need data verification. Expect a ping for one small metric.

mia: Awesome. Closing loop here — ping me if anything slips. "
